[[Kahturin Hovohden]] can found patrolling the entrance to the [[Citadel of Dzagon]].

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The [[Kournan military|Kournans]] got new siege weapons from [[Cantha]]. Now we have to upgrade our defenses. It's a constant fight to keep ahead. I guess it's important to have the newest weapons, but shouldn't we learn to use them before they're outdated?"''

==Quotes==
:''"I can't believe that wall broke again. Can't they ever build it right the first time?"''
